# Customer C001, Acme, invoiced in CAD, and nothing else.
#
# Read into a book before a transaction whose split states
# `lot_owner: customer:C001`, which needs the customer to exist already.
#
# What this fixture produces: customer C001.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_credit_with_no_bank_side_is_listed.py.
customer "C001"
	name: "Acme"
	currency: CAD
